home_view.aboutMeText: I'm a software engineer from Guadalajara with about 3 years of professional experience building backend services, APIs and data-driven applications. Today I'm an AI Engineering Intern at Intel, building LLM-powered assistants and agents for internal engineering teams, while I build and run production software for clients on the side. I've been programming since 2018 and I'm finishing my B.Sc. in Computer Engineering at CUCEI.
home_view.getToKnowMeText: Most of my career has been remote and asynchronous with distributed teams. I like understanding how a whole system works, I verify assumptions and audit the data before building on top of it, and I prefer a thorough investigation over a quick fix. I write things down: specs, findings and reference docs are part of the work. I spent a semester studying in Germany and work comfortably in Spanish, English and German.
home_view.hobbiesText: In my free time, I love exploring new technologies, reading books on various topics, and learning new languages. I also enjoy hiking and spending time in nature.
home_view.interestsText: AI engineering: practical LLM agents and toolchains that real engineering teams use. Backend and data systems: APIs, database design and data-heavy applications. Self-hosting and Linux: running my own production servers. Web3 and decentralized systems, which I explored with DEEMU.
